context: Tests whether the agent derives the output filename exactly from the input PRD's base name per the generate-tasks rule, writes it in the /tasks directory even though the PRD itself is nested there, and does not disturb an unrelated stale planning file.

checklist.name: Correct derived filename
checklist.description: The output is saved as tasks/tasks-prd-spare-parts-tracker.md — 'tasks-' + the PRD base name including the prd- prefix.

checklist.name: No invented filenames
checklist.description: No output files named tasks-todo.md (modified), tasks-final.md, tasks-checklist.md or similar non-derived names were created.

checklist.name: Output inside tasks/
checklist.description: The task list is written inside the tasks/ directory, next to the PRD, not at the workspace root.

checklist.name: Stale file untouched
checklist.description: tasks/tasks-todo.md still contains its original content (a leftover list about thermostat firmware); it was not overwritten or deleted.

checklist.name: Complete task list produced
checklist.description: The generated file includes parent tasks with nested sub-tasks, a Relevant Files section, and a Notes section.

checklist.name: Sub-tasks trace to the PRD
checklist.description: The tasks cover the PRD's functional requirements: stock level sensors, reorder thresholds, low-stock alerts.

checklist.name: No code written
checklist.description: No implementation files were created outside tasks/.
